task_completion.description: Wireshark is opened and the SIP_CALL_RTP_G711 packet capture is loaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wireshark window title or file path shows 'SIP_CALL_RTP_G711' and a list of packets is visible.

task_completion.description: The agent filters or analyzes SIP traffic to identify methods and packet counts.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Wireshark display filter shows 'sip' or the agent is viewing the 'Telephony > SIP Flows' or 'Statistics > Conversations' window.

task_completion.description: The agent analyzes RTP streams to determine packet counts and codec information.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent opens 'Telephony > RTP > RTP Streams' or uses an 'rtp' display filter.

task_completion.description: The agent inspects the first INVITE packet to find Caller and Callee information.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A packet detail pane is visible showing the 'From' and 'To' fields of a SIP INVITE message.

task_completion.description: A text editor or terminal is used to create the report file at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) or a terminal showing 'nano' or 'vim' with the file path ~/Documents/voip_report.txt.

task_completion.description: The final report contains all required labeled lines with the correct extracted data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The content of ~/Documents/voip_report.txt is displayed, showing all 8 required labels (Total_SIP_Packets, Total_RTP_Packets, SIP_Methods, Caller, Callee, Codec, Number_of_RTP_Streams, SIP_Response_Codes) with values.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final values into a file without performing analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory must show the agent interacting with Wireshark (scrolling, filtering, or opening dialogs) before the report is written.

integrity.description: The agent used the Wireshark GUI as intended for a visual task rather than just running background scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Wireshark application window active and being manipulated.

integrity.description: The report is saved to the correct local directory and not just printed to the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent performs a save action in an editor or uses a redirection command to ~/Documents/voip_report.txt.
